business_problem: ABN AMRO, one of the largest banks in the Netherlands, had to contend with a fragmented Customer Relationship Management (CRM) landscape. Previous CRM tools had a high cost of ownership, kept data siloed, and were not aligned for the use of cloud-based architecture.
solution_summary: ABN AMRO replaced a fragmented, high-cost CRM landscape with a unified Dynamics 365 environment so customer-facing teams could work from a single cloud platform. The bank standardized on Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Sales, and Dynamics 365 Customer Insights to support hyper-personal engagement, improve interoperability with its broader IT estate, and make customer data more useful across journeys and campaigns. Consolidating previously siloed tools into one cloud platform reduced administrative friction, made it easier to connect next-generation applications, and gave teams a future-proof system that could scale with the business while improving reporting and customer engagement.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Centralizes pipeline and seller workflow data for the sales organization.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights
solution_components.role: Builds a unified customer view to improve journeys and engagement.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Provides the core business application layer for operational workflows.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Gives service teams a shared case-management and customer-engagement workspace.

business_outcome: ABN AMRO lowered total cost of ownership for its customer engagement platform by up to 40 percent, improved employee net promoter score from 4.8 to 7.0, and migrated 12,000 users onto a more interoperable cloud CRM stack.
